name: Curify ASL evaluation reference set
note: Reference items this evaluation scaffold can defend today. Does NOT assert that matching predictions exist yet - see asl-eval/status.py. REVISION 2026-08-30: 155 was removed from the scoreable set. Its corpus input was the caption-burned marketing OUTPUT, so the reference answer was visible in the model's input and every 155 score measured OCR rather than sign reading; see CONTAMINATION.md. A clean input is now in place but has no prediction. 1320 is likewise caption-burned and is now referenced through a masked input. 1434 remains excluded: greeting-only content, guessable from priors without decoding any signing.

items.note: As of 2026-08-30 this is the ONLY item in the corpus with both a verified human reference and an uncontaminated input. Every defensible accuracy claim about the ASL translator rests on this one video.

input_mask.verified_clean: band fully black in 4112 of 4112 frames (exhaustive per-frame pixel check)
input_mask.method: Unconditional ffmpeg drawbox over the caption band (y=795 h=155, full width, ALL frames), plus full-frame black over the two title/instruction cards (t<15.0 and t>132.1, the ranges where the signer is absent). Re-encoded libx264 crf 18; duration and frame count unchanged.

items.production_direction: RESOLVED 2026-08-30. Title cards read 'Certificate Program for Sign Language Interpreters - RECEPTIVE SKILLS EVALUATION' / 'SIGN TO VOICE' / 'Record yourself voicing the video'. An interpreter certification exercise: the ASL is the source and the captions are the answer key. This was the blocker recorded in the spec as SS9.5; it no longer applies. What remains is an annotator confirming the caption text against the actual signing.

excluded.note: Held verified_gold / usable_for_official_metrics=true until 2026-08-30. The file at videos/155_....mp4 was byte-identical to curify-frontend/public/video/asl-demo-translation.mp4 - the published demo OUTPUT, with the English captions burned in. The temperature0 prediction reproduces the gold SRT verbatim including punctuation, with 0 substitutions and 0 deletions, and its two 'duplicate' segments are two batches reading the same caption while it was still on screen. All 155 scores are retracted. A clean input (the raw demo source) is now at videos/155_....mp4, but no prediction has been generated from it, so the item cannot re-enter the scoreable set yet.
README warns this clip covers only the greeting exchange, the highest-prior content in ASL; a model can score ~65% by guessing without decoding any signing. Not an acceptance item.
